Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Additional Terms & Conditions (ATC) for hiring of vehicles services for Central TB Division(CTD), Jeevan Vihar Buidling, Sansad Marg, New Del hi The Bidder shall mandatorily upload a duly filled-in index clearly indicating the page numbers against each documents submitted in the bid. Bids without duly f

illed in index will be disqualified and shall not be considered further. 2. The firm/agency should be registered under the jurisdiction of GST, Delhi. Th e registered office of the firm/agency shall be located within the National Capita l Territory (NCT) of Delhi. The successful bidder shall ensure that the requisition ed vehicle is made available at CTD within 30 minutes of requisition by the buyer. 3. The Bidder shall upload a certificate of self-declaration/undertaking on the l etterhead of the firm with date (not before publication of Bid) stating that the fir m has not been blacklisted/debarred by any Ministry/Departments or DoE and is not under any criminal proceedings or guilty of security breach and is not under bankruptcy. An undertaking submitted without date or not on the letterhead of t he firm shall be liable for rejection. 4. When requested by the department, the contractor shall be bound to provide vehicles (upto 100 percent of contracted number of vehicles) on day to day bas is on pro-rata basis of monthly package in addition to contracted number of veh icles. In this category Distance/dead mileage will be counted from the place of t he requirement., duly signed by the concerned officials. 5. The Department reserves the right to increase or decrease the number of v ehicles by up to 50% of the quantity specified in the bid. 6. The firm shall comply with all applicable statutory provisions relating to the s ervices offered by it. The vehicles deployed by the firm should fulfill all the nor ms prescribed by the Ministry of RT&H, Transport Department of Govt. of NCT of Delhi, CPCB and other statutory requirements. 7. Contract period may be extended for a further period of 01 year as per mutu al consent based on satisfactory services. 8. The bidder has to submit copies of valid RCs (commercial) of all vehicles regi stered in the name of firm / owner / director. 9. In case of extra running or extra Hours even beyond 25% of the package, pa yment of extra Kms & extra Hours will be made as per formula given at Service Level Agreement (SLA). No additional package can be claimed. 10. The successful bidder shall provide a 24×7 operational mobile number with WhatsApp facility, alongwith an escalation matrix to facilitate communication b etween the Department and the Contractor. 11. The vehicles and drivers should be deployed to the satisfaction of the buyer . The contractor shall ensure that vehicles and drivers once deployed, shall not be changed arbitrarily, without prior consent of the buyer.

12. The drivers deployed under the contract must possess a valid driving licenc e, have a minumum of two years of driving experience, should be well behaved and fully conversant with the routes of Delhi NCR. The antecedents of drivers to be deployed should be properly verified by the contractor. 13. The vehicles to be deployed under the contract shall be Petrol/CNG fuelled only. They should be clean, properly maintained and have functional air conditioning at all times during the deployment. 14. The successful bidder shall be responsible for maintenance and upkeep of t he vehicles, fuel, insurance , PUC certificate, Permits, fitness certificate and rep airs & servicing along with all accident handling with regulatory issues and will b e required to submit copies of RCs, Insurance Papers, PUC Certificates, Permits, Fitness Certificate and all other applicable statutory documents in respect of th e vehicles deployed within 15 days from the date of award of contract. 15. The buyer shall have the right to cancel the bid, if any material/documents provided by the bidder is found to be false at later stage. 16. Toll charges incurred by the service provider shall be reimbursed by the bu yer upon production of proof of toll payment in original. . 2.
